premise.claim: analyzePlayed() is gated on lastGame (component state, cleared on newGame/navigation) so finishing a game + navigating away never analyses it -> no puzzles, no weaknessCounters fold, and the next game's opening-steer silently falls back to neutral.
evidence: Play.svelte:456 analyzePlayed() opens with `if (!lastGame || !model) return;` — hard gate on lastGame.
Play.svelte:81 `let lastGame = $state<{id;pgn}|null>(null)` is COMPONENT state, not persisted.
Play.svelte:132 newGame() sets `lastGame = null` (also aResult/aStatus reset) — so starting the next game discards the just-finished game's analysis affordance.

Play.svelte:619 the Analyse button only renders `{#if status==='over' && lastGame && variant!=='chess960'}` — leaving the over screen (navigation unmounts Play; lastGame is component-local) removes the only entry point.

Steer fallback CONFIRMED: newGame() (Play.svelte:159-168) calls loadAllAnalyses(); if `analyses.length` is 0 -> weakest stays null -> selectOpening(botColor, null, rng) weights every opening 1:1 (openingBook.ts:91 `weakest && o.targets===weakest ? 3 : 1`) = neutral variety; steeringNote(opening, null) returns 'Playing the X' (openingBook.ts:131). So an un-analysed history yields neutral steering — exactly the broken loop.
